result.title: GaLF-ST: Gaussian Latent Fields for Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction
result.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. We will release the appendix and code with a future version of this preprint
result.summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression at known tissue locations to reveal tissue organization and cellular function. Expression prediction requires modeling both local spatial relationships and associations among genes. Existing methods typically model expression using coordinate networks without explicit spatial parameterization. To address limited spatial sampling and sparse expression observations of ST, some methods firstly fit intermediate embeddings and then train expression predictors, but a latent representation suited to expression reconstruction may be difficult to predict from spatial coordinates. The two training stages can impose different demands on the latent representation. In this paper, we propose GaLF-ST, a Gaussian latent field method in which learnable Gaussian centers and anisotropic covariances determine the weights of latent vectors at each location. A shared nonlinear decoder maps their weighted average to multigene expression. In GaLF-ST, observed expression error jointly updates the Gaussian geometry, latent vectors, and decoder parameters. We further establish a unified benchmark across seven dataset groups and three held-out fractions, comparing GaLF-ST with four representative methods using the same locations, splits, gene panels, and scoring rules. Across tissues and observation densities, GaLF-ST achieves leading overall reconstruction performance, recovering spatial gene expression patterns and preserving tissue domains from limited observations while substantially reducing runtime and GPU memory usage.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为空间转录组建模提出 GaLF-ST：用可学习的高斯中心与各向异性协方差决定各位置 latent 向量的权重，由共享非线性解码器把加权平均映射为多基因表达，并以表达误差联合更新高斯几何、latent 与解码器，同时给出跨七组数据的统一基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其「按空间几何加权聚合 latent 并与内容联合优化」的隐场参数化，可能为按位置调制 latent 状态、避免两阶段表示不匹配提供远距离参照，可供核查。
